verses.sanskrit:
ज्योतीरूपाय विद्महे सहस्रशीर्षाय धीमहि ।
तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात् ॥
verses.translation: We meditate upon the one with a thousand heads, the form of light. May Rudra inspire and enlighten our consciousness.

verses.sanskrit:
नमस्ते अस्तु भगवन् विश्वेश्वराय महादेवाय त्र्यम्बकाय ।
त्रिपुरान्तकाय त्रिकालाग्निकालाय कालाग्निरुद्राय नमः ॥
verses.translation: Salutations to You, O Bhagavan, Lord of the universe, Mahadeva, Three-eyed One, Destroyer of the three cities, Time of the three-fold fire of time — salutations to Kalagni Rudra.
